title: My working schedule
subtitle: Review your current schedule and plan future appointment hours.
monthHint: We show 3 months from the selected date. The Zone A / Zone B boundary follows the bookable month (today → +1 month −1 day).

zoneA.title: Current schedule
zoneA.callout: Parameters for this period are frozen. Only cancellations or vacation on empty days are available.
zoneA.cancelReasonHint: The patient will see this in the cancellation notification
zoneA.vacationHint: Only for days with no appointments after a bulk cancel.

zoneB.title: Future schedule
zoneB.callout: New parameters apply from {{date}} — the first day after Zone A. There are no appointments in this period yet.
zoneB.priceHint: Applies from the first day after Zone A · profile shows bookable price

important.title: Good to know
important.b1: Visit format (offline / online / both) is set in Zone B and affects what patients see.
important.b2: Zone B changes do not alter existing bookings in Zone A.
important.b3: Cancel individual visits from the doctor day screen; use this page for bulk cancel in Zone A.

modals.bulkBody: Patients will get an in-app notification. The doctor is the cancelling party. This action cannot be undone for these visits.
modals.bulkWarning: Nothing is cancelled silently. Confirmation is required — patients will see that the doctor cancelled the visit.
modals.vacationABody: Only available for days with no appointments after a bulk cancel.
modals.vacationANote: Hours stay frozen. Vacation only marks the day as off — patients cannot book.
modals.vacationBBody: There are no bookings in Zone B — you can plan free days.
modals.vacationBNote: Changes apply only to Zone B. Working hours and appointments in Zone A stay unchanged.
modals.saveBNote: Existing visits in Zone A are unchanged. No silent cancellations.
